facts: Internet Explorer Mobile is a discontinued mobile browser.
Internet Explorer Mobile was formerly named Pocket Internet Explorer.
Internet Explorer Mobile is commonly abbreviated to IE Mobile.
Internet Explorer Mobile was developed by Microsoft.
Internet Explorer Mobile is based on versions of the Trident layout engine.
IE Mobile comes loaded by default with Windows Phone.
IE Mobile comes loaded by default with Windows CE.
Later versions of Internet Explorer Mobile since Windows Phone 8 are based on the desktop version of Internet Explorer.
Older versions of Internet Explorer Mobile called Pocket Internet Explorer are not based on the same layout engine.
Pocket Internet Explorer is found on Windows Phone 7.
Pocket Internet Explorer is found on Windows Mobile.
Internet Explorer Mobile 11 is the last version that was supported.
Internet Explorer Mobile 11 is based on the desktop version of Internet Explorer 11.
Internet Explorer Mobile 11 came with Windows Phone 8.1.
Microsoft Edge replaced Internet Explorer Mobile in Windows 10 Mobile.
